cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Don't leave the allotment until we've weighed both pumpkins.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then you won't mind witnessing how much bigger.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow you'll say the scales were generous. Stay for the number.

mechanism: A insists on professional measurement and witnessing to keep a rival present until the pumpkin contest has a recorded result.
confusable: D173 seeks shared verification; D194 specifically prevents departure before the outcome is undeniable.
comparison: A friendly contest and delayed weighing differ from immediate financial settlement.
seedUse: Keep size concession/tomorrow evasion; use specific weighing procedure rather than prediction of future excuses.
